metadata.architect_diagnosis: No generic setDrivenKeyframe primitive was found. Added an injectable Setup boundary that consumes the Scene-owned weight schedule, validates plugs/row widths, applies driver and driven values, keys each driven plug, and restores the original driver value even on failure. Partial keys created before a Maya failure are intentionally not rolled back and remain a higher transaction concern.

metadata.purpose: Prove the isolated driven-key schedule application contract before proxy/visibility and final Scene transaction composition.
acceptance: Compile/import driven_keys and its smoke, then run DrivenKeysSmokeTest.
Verify each schedule row sets driver then driven weights and calls setDrivenKeyframe with currentDriver; verify original driver restoration on success and failure and reject invalid plugs/row widths.
Do not claim rollback of already-created keys, tangent parity or Maya runtime parity unless separately proven; do not use Codex.
